heading.en: Ammon glories in the Lord—The faithful are strengthened by the Lord and are given knowledge—By faith men may bring thousands of souls unto repentance—God has all power and comprehends all things. About 90–77 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua olioli Amona i le Alii—E faamalosi e le Alii ē faamaoni ma tuuina mai ia te i latou le malamalama—O le faatuatua e mafai ai e tagata ona aumaia le afe ma afe o agaga i le salamo—Ua i ai i le Atua le mana uma ma ua ia silafia mea uma. E tusa o le 90–77 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now, these are the words of Ammon to his brethren, which say thus: My brothers and my brethren, behold I say unto you, how great reason have we to rejoice; for could we have supposed when we started from the land of Zarahemla that God would have granted unto us such great blessings?
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, o upu nei a Amona i ona uso, ua faapea ona fai atu: Ou uso e, ma le au uso, faauta ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua tele lava se pogai tatou te olioli ai; ona sa mafai ea ona tatou manatu ina ua tatou amata mai le laueleele o Sara’emila, o le a tuuina mai e le Atua ia te i tatou ni faamanuiaga tetele faapenei?

verses.en: And now, I ask, what great blessings has he bestowed upon us? Can ye tell?
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ou te fesili atu, o a faamanuiaga silisili ua ia tuuina mai ia te i tatou? E mafai ona outou ta’u mai?

verses.en: Behold, I answer for you; for our brethren, the Lamanites, were in darkness, yea, even in the darkest abyss, but behold, how many of them are brought to behold the marvelous light of God! And this is the blessing which hath been bestowed upon us, that we have been made instruments in the hands of God to bring about this great work.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te tali atu mo outou; ona o o tatou uso, o sa Lamanā, sa i ai i le pouliuli, ioe, i se to ua sili lava ona pouliuli; ae faauta, i le toatele o i latou ua aumai e vaai i le malamalama ofoofogia o le Atua! Ma o le faamanuiaga lenei ua faaee mai i o tatou luga, lea ua avea ai i tatou o ni meafaigaluega i aao o le Atua e faataunuu ai lenei galuega tele.

verses.en: Behold, thousands of them do rejoice, and have been brought into the fold of God.
verses.sm: Faauta, e afe ma afe i latou ua olioli, ma ua aumai i le faapotopotoga a le Atua.

verses.en: Behold, the field was ripe, and blessed are ye, for ye did thrust in the sickle, and did reap with your might, yea, all the day long did ye labor; and behold the number of your sheaves! And they shall be gathered into the garners, that they are not wasted.
verses.sm: Faauta, sa matua le faatoaga, ma amuia lava outou, ona sa outou sasau atu le selesaito, ma outou selesele mai ma lo outou malosi, ioe, sa outou galulue i le aso atoa; ma faauta i le tele o a outou fusisaito! Ma o le a faaputuputuina i latou i falesaito, ina ia le faama’umauina i latou.

verses.en: Yea, they shall not be beaten down by the storm at the last day; yea, neither shall they be harrowed up by the whirlwinds; but when the storm cometh they shall be gathered together in their place, that the storm cannot penetrate to them; yea, neither shall they be driven with fierce winds whithersoever the enemy listeth to carry them.
verses.sm: Ioe, o le a le taia i latou i lalo e le afā i le aso gataaga; ioe, pe lagā foi i luga i latou e le asiosio; ae a sau le afā o le a faaputuputu faatasi i latou i o latou nofoaga, ina ia le mafai e le afā ona ulu atu ia te i latou; ioe, pe faalelea foi i latou e matagi malolosi i soo se mea e manao le fili e ave i ai i latou.

verses.en: But behold, they are in the hands of the Lord of the harvest, and they are his; and he will raise them up at the last day.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ua i ai i latou i aao o le Alii o le seleselega, ma o i latou o ana; ma o le a ia faatutū a’e i latou i luga i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: Blessed be the name of our God; let us sing to his praise, yea, let us give thanks to his holy name, for he doth work righteousness forever.
verses.sm: Ia faamanūina lava le suafa o lo tatou Atua; ia tatou pepese i lona viiga, ioe, ia tatou avatu le faafetai i lona suafa paia, ona ua faia e ia le amiotonu e faavavau.

verses.en: For if we had not come up out of the land of Zarahemla, these our dearly beloved brethren, who have so dearly beloved us, would still have been racked with hatred against us, yea, and they would also have been strangers to God.
verses.sm: Auā a na tatou le o a’e mai le laueleele o Sara’emila, o o tatou uso pele nei, o e ua sili ona alolofa ia te i tatou, po ua mafatia pea i latou i le ita faasaga mai ia te i tatou, ioe, ma po ua avea foi i latou o ni tagata ese i le Atua.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Ammon had said these words, his brother Aaron rebuked him, saying: Ammon, I fear that thy joy doth carry thee away unto boasting.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona fai mai e Amona nei upu, sa a’oa’i atu lona uso o Arona ia te ia, e faapea: Amona e, ou te fefe o lou olioli o le a fai ma mea e te mitamitavale ai.

verses.en: But Ammon said unto him: I do not boast in my own strength, nor in my own wisdom; but behold, my joy is full, yea, my heart is brim with joy, and I will rejoice in my God.
verses.sm: Ae sa fai mai Amona ia te ia: Ou te le mitamita i lo’u lava malosi, po o lo’u lava poto; ae faauta, ua atoatoa lo’u olioli, ioe, ua tumu lo’u loto i le olioli, ma o le a ou olioli i lo’u Atua.

verses.en: Yea, I know that I am nothing; as to my strength I am weak; therefore I will not boast of myself, but I will boast of my God, for in his strength I can do all things; yea, behold, many mighty miracles we have wrought in this land, for which we will praise his name forever.
verses.sm: Ioe, ua ou iloa o a’u o se tagata noa; a faatatau i lo’u malosi ou te vaivai; o lea ou te le mitamita ai ia te a’u lava ia, ae ou te mitamita i lo’u Atua, ona o lona malosi e mafai ai ona ou faia o mea uma; ioe, faauta, e tele vavega tetele ua tatou faia i lenei laueleele, o mea o le a tatou viia ai lona suafa e faavavau.

verses.en: Behold, how many thousands of our brethren has he loosed from the pains of hell; and they are brought to sing redeeming love, and this because of the power of his word which is in us, therefore have we not great reason to rejoice?
verses.sm: Faauta, e fia le tele o afe o o tatou uso ua ia tatalaina mai tiga o seoli; ma ua aumai ai i latou e usuina le alofa togiola, ma ua tupu mai lenei mea ona o le mana o lana afioga ua i totonu o i tatou, o lea, po ua le i ai ea ia te i tatou se pogai tele tatou te olioli ai?

verses.en: Yea, we have reason to praise him forever, for he is the Most High God, and has loosed our brethren from the chains of hell.
verses.sm: Ioe, ua ia i tatou se pogai e viia ai o ia e faavavau, ona o ia o le Atua Silisili Ese, ma ua ia tatalaina o tatou uso mai filifili o seoli.

verses.en: Yea, they were encircled about with everlasting darkness and destruction; but behold, he has brought them into his everlasting light, yea, into everlasting salvation; and they are encircled about with the matchless bounty of his love; yea, and we have been instruments in his hands of doing this great and marvelous work.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa siosiomia faataamilo i latou i le pouliuli ma le faafanoga tumau e faavavau; ae faauta, ua ia aumai i latou i lona malamalama tumau e faavavau, ioe, i le faaolataga tumau e faavavau, ma ua siosiomia faataamilo i latou i le tele lē mafaatusalia o lona alofa; ioe, ma ua avea i tatou o ni meafaigaluega i ona aao i le faia o lenei galuega tele ma le ofoofogia.

verses.en: Therefore, let us glory, yea, we will glory in the Lord; yea, we will rejoice, for our joy is full; yea, we will praise our God forever. Behold, who can glory too much in the Lord? Yea, who can say too much of his great power, and of his mercy, and of his long-suffering towards the children of men? Behold, I say unto you, I cannot say the smallest part which I feel.
verses.sm: O lea, ia tatou mitamita ai, ioe, o le a tatou mitamita i le Alii; ioe, o le a tatou olioli, ona ua atoatoa lo tatou olioli; ioe, o le a tatou viia lo tatou Atua e faavavau. Faauta, o ai ea e mafai ona tele naua lona mitamita i le Alii? Ioe, o ai e mafai ona tele naua upu na te faia e uiga i lona mana tele, ma e uiga i lona alofa mutimutivale, ma i lona tali-tiga i le fanauga a tagata? Faauta, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e le mafai ona ou fai atu se vaega itiiti o le mea ua ou lagona.

verses.en: Who could have supposed that our God would have been so merciful as to have snatched us from our awful, sinful, and polluted state?
verses.sm: O ai sa mafai ona manatu o le a alofa mutimutivale tele mai lo tatou Atua ua vave aveese ai i tatou mai lo tatou tulaga leaga matautia, ma agasala, ma eleelea?

verses.en: Behold, we went forth even in wrath, with mighty threatenings to destroy his church.
verses.sm: Faauta, sa tatou o atu i le ita, ma le faamata’u tele e faaumatia lana ekalesia.

verses.en: Oh then, why did he not consign us to an awful destruction, yea, why did he not let the sword of his justice fall upon us, and doom us to eternal despair?
verses.sm: O lea, aisea na ia le tuu atu ai i tatou i se faafanoga matautia, ioe, aisea na ia le faapa’ū ifo ai i o tatou luga le pelu o lana faamasinotonu, ma faamalaia i tatou i le noa ma se faamoemoe e faavavau?

verses.en: Oh, my soul, almost as it were, fleeth at the thought. Behold, he did not exercise his justice upon us, but in his great mercy hath brought us over that everlasting gulf of death and misery, even to the salvation of our souls.
verses.sm: E, lou agaga e, e toetoe lava, ia sola ese mai lea manatu. Faauta, sa ia le faatinoina lana faamasinotonu i luga o i tatou, ae na ia aumai i tatou i lona alofa mutimutivale tele i luga o lena vanu tumau e faavavau o le oti ma le pagatia, mo le faaolaina lava o o tatou agaga.

verses.en: And now behold, my brethren, what natural man is there that knoweth these things? I say unto you, there is none that knoweth these things, save it be the penitent.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, o’u uso e, o ai se tagata natura o i ai ua ia iloaina nei mea? Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua leai se tasi ua ia iloaina nei mea, vagana ai i latou ua salamo.

verses.en: Yea, he that repenteth and exerciseth faith, and bringeth forth good works, and prayeth continually without ceasing—unto such it is given to know the mysteries of God; yea, unto such it shall be given to reveal things which never have been revealed; yea, and it shall be given unto such to bring thousands of souls to repentance, even as it has been given unto us to bring these our brethren to repentance.
verses.sm: Ioe, o ia o lē e salamo ma faatino le faatuatua, ma fai galuega lelei, ma tatalo pea e le aunoa— o i latou ia ua tuuina mai ia iloa mealilo a le Atua; ioe, o i latou ia e tuuina mai i ai latou te faaali mai mea e lei faaalia lava; ioe, ma o le a tuuina mai latou te aumai le afe ma afe o agaga i le salamo, e pei lava ona tuuina mai ia i tatou e aumai o tatou uso nei i le salamo.

verses.en: Now do ye remember, my brethren, that we said unto our brethren in the land of Zarahemla, we go up to the land of Nephi, to preach unto our brethren, the Lamanites, and they laughed us to scorn?
verses.sm: O lenei pe tou te manatua ea, o’u uso e, sa tatou fai atu i o tatou uso i le laueleele o Sara’emila, o le a tatou o a’e i le laueleele o Nifae, e tala’i atu i o tatou uso, o sa Lamanā, ma sa latou tōē faatauemu mai ia te i tatou.

w.en: the go up to the land

verses.en: For they said unto us: Do ye suppose that ye can bring the Lamanites to the knowledge of the truth? Do ye suppose that ye can convince the Lamanites of the incorrectness of the traditions of their fathers, as stiffnecked a people as they are; whose hearts delight in the shedding of blood; whose days have been spent in the grossest iniquity; whose ways have been the ways of a transgressor from the beginning? Now my brethren, ye remember that this was their language.
verses.sm: Ona sa latou fai mai ia te i tatou: Tou te manatu ea e mafai ona outou aumaia sa Lamanā i le malamalama o le upumoni? Tou te manatu e mafai ona outou faatalitonuina sa Lamanā i le sesē o uputuu a o latou tamā, ao avea pea i latou ma tagata ua maaa e pei ona latou i ai nei; o ē ua fiafia o latou loto i le faamasaaina o le toto; o ē ua faaaluina o latou aso i le amioletonu sili ona leaga; o ē o o latou ala o ala o sē na solitulafono mai i le amataga? O lenei, o’u uso e, tou te manatua o la latou gagana lena.

verses.en: And moreover they did say: Let us take up arms against them, that we destroy them and their iniquity out of the land, lest they overrun us and destroy us.
verses.sm: Ma e le gata i lea, sa latou fai mai: Ia tatou sii auupega o taua e faasaga ia te i latou, ina ia tatou faaumatia ese i latou ma lo latou amioletonu mai le laueleele, nei latou solia i tatou ma faaumatia i tatou.

verses.en: But behold, my beloved brethren, we came into the wilderness not with the intent to destroy our brethren, but with the intent that perhaps we might save some few of their souls.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ou uso pele e, sa tatou lei o mai i le vao ma le faamoemoe e faaumatia o tatou uso, ae ma le faamoemoe atonu e mafai ona tatou faaolaina ni isi e toaitiiti o o latou agaga.

verses.en: Now when our hearts were depressed, and we were about to turn back, behold, the Lord comforted us, and said: Go amongst thy brethren, the Lamanites, and bear with patience thine afflictions, and I will give unto you success.
verses.sm: O lenei ina ua vaivai o tatou loto, ma toetoe a tatou toe foi i tua, faauta, sa faamafanafanaina i tatou e le Alii, ma fetalai mai: O atu i totonu o o outou uso, o sa Lamanā, ma tauave ma le onosai o outou puapuaga, ma o le a ou tuu atu ia te outou le manuia.

verses.en: And now behold, we have come, and been forth amongst them; and we have been patient in our sufferings, and we have suffered every privation; yea, we have traveled from house to house, relying upon the mercies of the world—not upon the mercies of the world alone but upon the mercies of God.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, ua tatou o mai, ma ua tatou i ai i totonu ia te i latou; ma sa tatou onosai i o tatou mafatiaga, ma sa tatou mafatia i mea uma sa tatou manaomia; ioe, sa tatou malaga atu mai lea fale i lea fale, ma faalagolago i luga o le mutimutialofa o le lalolagi— e le na’o luga o le mutimutialofa o le lalolagi, ae i luga foi o le alofa mutimutivale o le Atua.

verses.en: And we have entered into their houses and taught them, and we have taught them in their streets; yea, and we have taught them upon their hills; and we have also entered into their temples and their synagogues and taught them; and we have been cast out, and mocked, and spit upon, and smote upon our cheeks; and we have been stoned, and taken and bound with strong cords, and cast into prison; and through the power and wisdom of God we have been delivered again.
verses.sm: Ma sa tatou ulu atu i totonu o o latou fale ma aoao i latou, ma sa tatou a’oa’o i latou i o latou auala; ioe, ma sa tatou a’oa’o i latou i luga o o latou mea maupuepue; ma sa tatou ulu atu foi i o latou malumalu ma o latou sunako ma a’oa’o i latou; ma sa tutuli i tatou i fafo, ma tauemua, ma feanu tagata i o tatou luga, ma fepō o tatou alafau; ma sa fetogi i tatou i maa, ma ave ma saisai i maea malolosi, ma lafo i le falepuipui; ma sa toe laveaiina i tatou e ala i le mana ma le poto o le Atua.

verses.en: And we have suffered all manner of afflictions, and all this, that perhaps we might be the means of saving some soul; and we supposed that our joy would be full if perhaps we could be the means of saving some.
verses.sm: Ma sa tatou mafatia i ituaiga uma o puapuaga, ma o nei mea uma na tutupu mai, atonu ina ia mafai ona avea ai i tatou ma ala e faaolaina ai ni nai agaga; ma sa tatou manatu o le a atoatoa lo tatou olioli pe afai e mafai ona avea i tatou ma ala e faaolaina ai ni isi.

verses.en: Now behold, we can look forth and see the fruits of our labors; and are they few? I say unto you, Nay, they are many; yea, and we can witness of their sincerity, because of their love towards their brethren and also towards us.
verses.sm: O lenei faauta, e mafai ona tatou vaai atu ma vaai i fua o a tatou galuega; ma ua itiiti ea i latou? Ou te fai atu ia te outou, E leai, ua toatele i latou; ioe, ma e mafai ona tatou molimau i lo latou faamaoni, ona o lo latou alolofa i o latou uso ma ia i tatou foi.

verses.en: For behold, they had rather sacrifice their lives than even to take the life of their enemy; and they have buried their weapons of war deep in the earth, because of their love towards their brethren.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, sa sili ia i latou le taulagaina o o latou ola nai lo le ave o le ola o so latou fili; ma ua latou tanumia loloto i le eleele a latou auupega o taua, ona o lo latou alolofa i o latou uso.

verses.en: And now behold I say unto you, has there been so great love in all the land? Behold, I say unto you, Nay, there has not, even among the Nephites.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta ou te fai atu ia te outou, sa i ai ea se alofa tele faapea i le laueleele atoa? Faauta, ou te fai atu ia te outou, E leai, sa le’i i ai lava, e oo lava i totonu o sa Nifaē.

verses.en: For behold, they would take up arms against their brethren; they would not suffer themselves to be slain. But behold how many of these have laid down their lives; and we know that they have gone to their God, because of their love and of their hatred to sin.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, latou te sii auupega o taua e faasaga i o latou uso; latou te le fia tuu i latou lava ia fasiotia. Ae faauta pe toafia ea o i latou nei na tuuina atu o latou ola; ma ua tatou iloa ua latou o atu i lo latou Atua, ona o lo latou alolofa ma ona o lo latou inoino i le agasala.

verses.en: Now have we not reason to rejoice? Yea, I say unto you, there never were men that had so great reason to rejoice as we, since the world began; yea, and my joy is carried away, even unto boasting in my God; for he has all power, all wisdom, and all understanding; he comprehendeth all things, and he is a merciful Being, even unto salvation, to those who will repent and believe on his name.
verses.sm: O lenei pe le ua i ai ea ia te i tatou se pogai tatou te olioli ai? Ioe, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e le’i i ai lava ni tagata na i ai se pogai tele naua latou te olioli ai e pei o i tatou, talu mai le amataga o le lalolagi; ioe, ma ua soona tele lava lo’u olioli, ua oo lava i le mitamita i lo’u Atua; ona ua ia te ia le mana uma, ma le poto atoa, ma le malamalama uma; ua silafia e ia mea uma, ma o ia o Lē alofa mutimutivale, e oo lava i le faaolataga, o i latou o ē e salamo ma talitonu i lona suafa.

verses.en: Now if this is boasting, even so will I boast; for this is my life and my light, my joy and my salvation, and my redemption from everlasting wo. Yea, blessed is the name of my God, who has been mindful of this people, who are a branch of the tree of Israel, and has been lost from its body in a strange land; yea, I say, blessed be the name of my God, who has been mindful of us, wanderers in a strange land.
verses.sm: O lenei afai o le mitamitavale lea, o le a faapea lava ona ou mitamita; ona o lo’u ola ma lo’u sulu lea, o lo’u olioli ma lo’u faaolataga, ma lo’u togiola lea mai le malaia tumau e faavavau. Ioe, ia faamanūina lava le suafa o lo’u Atua, o le ua manatu mai i lenei nuu, o ē o se lālā o le laau o Isaraelu, ma ua vavaeeseina mai i lona tino atoa i se laueleele ese; ioe, ou te fai atu, ia faamanūina lava le suafa o lo’u Atua, o lē ua manatu mai ia te i tatou, o ni tagata taase i se laueleele ese.

verses.en: Now my brethren, we see that God is mindful of every people, whatsoever land they may be in; yea, he numbereth his people, and his bowels of mercy are over all the earth. Now this is my joy, and my great thanksgiving; yea, and I will give thanks unto my God forever. Amen.
verses.sm: O lenei o’u uso e, ua tatou vaai e manatu mai le Atua i tagata uma, i soo se laueleele lava atonu ua latou i ai; ioe, ua ia faitauina ona tagata, ma o lona liuliualo i le alofa mutimutivale ua i luga o le lalolagi uma. O lenei o lo’u olioli lea, ma la’u faafetai tele; ioe, ma o le a ou avatu le faafetai i lo’u Atua e faavavau. Amene.

w.en: which is the is my joy,
